subject: Azure Partner Center referral — handshake checklist for Contoso pilot
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Michael Bostrom <michael.bostrom@microsoft.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Azure Partner Center referral — handshake checklist for Contoso pilot

Michael,

Thanks for taking a look at the Contoso pilot intake last week. We want to make sure the referral handshake is tight before we start routing live leads into Partner Center. Attached is an initial owner_matrix_v1.csv with the account-level owner mapping we intend to push (tenant id, canonical account name, proposed Redwood owner, suggested Azure seller id).

Ask: can you confirm the following so we can finalize the checklist and send an updated owner_matrix_v2.csv?
- Does Partner Center require the seller Azure AD object id (GUID) or is the email sufficient for consent mapping?
- Any constraints on countable owner records per account for the pilot (we are planning a 50-account canary)?
- Are there any required fields in the PC intake (besides tenant id and primary owner) we should populate to avoid intake back-and-forth?

Proposed next steps on our side:
1) We’ll reconcile tenant IDs with your intake team (script attached once you confirm fields)
2) Publish owner_matrix_v2.csv to the shared Drive and drop the PC intake link in HubSpot
3) 30-min alignment call to confirm seller consent flow and routing (we can host)

Attachments: owner_matrix_v1.csv (stub)

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0179
From: Michael Bostrom <michael.bostrom@microsoft.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Azure Partner Center Intake <pc-intake@microsoft.com>
Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 09:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Azure Partner Center referral — handshake checklist for Contoso pilot

Kimberly,

Thanks for the clear write-up — this is a good approach. A few quick clarifications from the Partner Center side:
- Seller consent: we prefer the Azure AD object id (GUID) for deterministic mapping, but email + tenant pairing is acceptable for initial pilots. We’ll convert to object ids at commit if needed.
- Owner records: Partner Center allows up to 3 seller associations per subscription/account for referral routing; beyond that we treat additional associations as advisory only. For a 50-account canary, that will be fine.
- Required fields: tenant id, subscription id (if you have it), primary owner email, and a short justification text field for co-sell routing priority.

I’m attaching the PC intake template (pc-intake-template.xlsx). If you populate the justification column with a short value (one sentence) we can accelerate processing.

Next step: please send owner_matrix_v2.csv with the above fields. If you’d like, I can route the completed file to our intake team and pre-check it before you publish.

Cheers,
Michael Bostrom
Program Manager, Azure Partner Center
michael.bostrom@microsoft.com

Attachments: pc-intake-template.xlsx (stub)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Michael Bostrom <michael.bostrom@microsoft.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 14:27:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Azure Partner Center referral — handshake checklist for Contoso pilot

Michael — perfect, thanks.

We’ll populate subscription id where available and include the one-sentence justification column. Two quick follow-ups for Karthik and Vanessa:
- Karthik: we’ll need a small reconciliation job to canonicalize Contoso tenant ids with our CRM (HubSpot). I’ll attach the initial query once you confirm the required names for the mapping fields.
- Vanessa: can you confirm the 50-account canary window (we were thinking week of May 10) — we want to ensure CS and the field have an escalation lane.

I’ll aim to send owner_matrix_v2.csv by Tue EOD with the justification column filled. If Michael can pre-check via intake, that would speed the process.

Thanks,
Kim

Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 11:09:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Azure Partner Center referral — handshake checklist for Contoso pilot

Kim — quick technical notes from the reconciliation side: I pulled a sample of 20 Contoso accounts from HubSpot and matched by domain + subscription. A couple of items to watch for:
- Tenant collisions: Contoso has multiple tenants that map to the same canonical account name (we need to de-duplicate on primary contact and HubSpot account id).
- Mobile-only subscriptions: some subscriptions in PC do not surface subscription ids via the public APIs; we’ll mark those as candidate accounts and require manual review.

I’ve attached a small SQL script we’ll run against the CRM mirror to produce the canonical tenant->hubspot mapping (tenant_recon_query.sql stub). Plan: run reconciliation on Tue night and commit owner_matrix_v2.csv Wed morning.

Vanessa — please confirm we can run the canary week of May 10 and that CS will standby for initial escalations.

–Karthik

Attachments: tenant_recon_query.sql (stub)

Thanks team — this looks good and pragmatic. Approvals and asks: 
- Approve 50-account canary for week of May 10.
- Karthik: proceed with the tenant reconciliation and share results in the shared Drive.
- Kimberly: when you publish owner_matrix_v2.csv, please add the HubSpot record link column and upload to Drive (link preferred).
- Michael: when you pre-check the intake, please flag any subscription ids that will need manual review so we can triage before routing.

I’ll schedule a 30-min alignment call Thursday (calendar invite coming) to run through consent flow and escalation steps. Also attaching a short mutual_action_plan.docx (stub) that we can use as the working agenda.

Next step owner: Kimberly — publish v2 + drop Drive link in thread; cc CS and your solutions engineer.

Vanessa Ortiz
